Synopsis:
    Russian air strikes hit multiple Ukrainian regions killing nine civilians and injuring dozens, with attacks targeting residential areas, infrastructure, steel plants and iron ore facilities. Ukraine retaliated with drone strikes on Russian industrial sites including a synthetic rubber plant in Togliatti. Russia continues systematic targeting of Ukrainian energy and economic infrastructure. Cross-border incidents affected Moldova's airspace and border crossings.
